item.title: Pakistan's ambassador warns Iran too 'war-torn' to respond quickly as Trump extends strike deadline
item.summary: Pakistan's ambassador warns Iran's war-torn state is slowing U.S.-Iran talks as Islamabad pushes to facilitate diplomacy amid Trump's deadline extension.

item.title: Democrats pounce on $4 a gallon gas, blame Trump’s Iran war for ‘broken promise’
item.summary: Gas prices topping $4 per gallon, driven by the Iran war, are another broken promise by Trump, Rep. Suzan DelBene claims, as Democrats target GOP on costs.

item.title: WWE NXT stars descend on New York City ahead of final show before Stand & Deliver
item.summary: WWE NXT stars are gearing up for the final show before the Stand & Deliver premium live event and are hoping to have the upper hand ahead of the premium live event.

item.title: Katherine Schwarzenegger defends traditional marriage values after Chris Pratt builds dollhouse for daughters
item.summary: Chris Pratt won praise from wife Katherine Schwarzenegger after she shared a video of him sanding a handmade wooden dollhouse for their three kids.

item.title: Pelosi won't say if Democrats will impeach Trump if they retake power, but leaves door open
item.summary: Nancy Pelosi declined to say whether Democrats would pursue impeaching Trump if they regain power, saying the decision is up to a new Congress to make.

item.title: JD Vance releasing book about faith journey, conversion to Catholicism
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance's upcoming book "Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith," due June 16, may signal political ambitions, a new report suggests.

item.title: Trump admin eases asylum freeze for vetted migrants, keeps bans on ‘high-risk’ nations
item.summary: DHS eases asylum holds for vetted migrants from non-high-risk nations while keeping strict bans on 39 countries, including Afghanistan and Somalia, under Trump.

item.title: Tallest college basketball player ever, standing at 7-foot-9, entering transfer portal
item.summary: The tallest player in college basketball history, 7-foot-9 Olivier Rioux, is leaving the University of Florida, announcing his transfer decision via Instagram.

item.title: Experts debunk Tyler Robinson's ballistics claim: 'Unable to identify is not the same as ruled out'
item.summary: Robinson allegedly confessed to Kirk's murder in texts, but his defense points to inconclusive ATF bullet testing as potential exculpatory evidence.

item.title: DHS rips Jimmy Kimmel for mocking Secretary Markwayne Mullin's plumbing background
item.summary: The DHS called Jimmy Kimmel a "failed comedian" after he mocked Secretary Markwayne Mullin's plumbing background, defending Mullin's blue-collar roots.
